post.description:
Harvests the whole crop and reports its yield. Offered only while the bed is ready to harvest. Afterwards the bed is empty and can be sown again.

Only allowed when status is READY_TO_HARVEST.

Link.description: The affordance set of the state this answer shows, by the relation https://w3id.org/heart-rise/rels/forms: the acts it allows now (see x-heart-affordances)

post.description:
Sows one kind of seed in the bed at an optional depth. Offered only while the bed is empty. Afterwards the bed is planted and can be watered.

Only allowed when status is EMPTY.

Link.description: The affordance set of the state this answer shows, by the relation https://w3id.org/heart-rise/rels/forms: the acts it allows now (see x-heart-affordances)

post.description:
Adds the given millilitres of water to each cell. Offered only while the bed is planted. Each watering raises moisture and growth; once growth is high enough the bed is ready to harvest. Water that would raise moisture past 100 is refused; harvesting leaves the bed dry.

Only allowed when status is PLANTED.
